description: A listing that started before an invalidation is cached as fresh
old: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ (~z /\ ~l)) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"

description: An invalidation leaves a fresh list fresh
old: /\ cache' = IF cache = "fresh" THEN "stale" ELSE cache

description: A stale list is served from the cache
A modern list with a zero-TTL page is cached
old: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ (~z /\ ~l)) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"
new: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ ~l) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"

description: A need during a listing starts another listing instead of joining it
Pages are requested past the page limit
An invalid cursor restarts the listing every time
A legacy list is cached even after an invalidation during its listing
old: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ (~z /\ ~l)) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"
new: /\ cache' = IF era = "legacy" \/ (startGen = gen /\ ~z /\ ~l) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"

description: A failed listing leaves its waiters waiting
A new process keeps the previous process's list fresh
new:
/\ era' = e
    /\ gen' = gen + 1 /\ UNCHANGED cache

description: The last page asks for another page instead of finishing
old:
ELSE /\ page' = p /\ zeroTtl' = z /\ lapsed' = l
               /\ Finish(z, l)
new:
ELSE /\ page' = 0 /\ zeroTtl' = z /\ lapsed' = l /\ pending' = "first"
               /\ UNCHANGED <<listing, startGen, restarts, waiting, answer, cache, cacheGen,
                              cachedZero, cachedLapsed>>
               /\ UNCHANGED refusedVars

description: A modern list with a page that expired before the listing ended is cached
old: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ (~z /\ ~l)) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"
new: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ ~z) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"

description: A failed listing hands its waiters the failure even when a list was listed before
A failed listing makes the last list fresh, so it is served from the cache instead of listed again
old:
/\ lastAnswer' = lastAnswer
    /\ unavail' = unavail
    /\ UNCHANGED <<era, process, gen, cache, cacheGen, cachedZero, cachedLapsed, startGen,
                   page, restarts, zeroTtl, lapsed, servedStale, extraFetch>>
new:
/\ lastAnswer' = lastAnswer
    /\ unavail' = unavail
    /\ cache' = IF cache = "none" THEN cache ELSE "fresh"
    /\ cacheGen' = gen
    /\ cachedZero' = FALSE
    /\ cachedLapsed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<era, process, gen, startGen,
                   page, restarts, zeroTtl, lapsed, servedStale, extraFetch>>

description: A published list leaves the refusal in place
A new process leaves the refusal in place
A page request that the server never answered counts as a refusal
A refused page is not remembered
old:
/\ refused' = TRUE
    /\ lastAnswer' = "refused"
    /\ unavail' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<era, process, gen, cache,
new:
/\ refused' = refused
    /\ lastAnswer' = "refused"
    /\ unavail' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<era, process, gen, cache,

description: An invalid cursor again after the restart is not a refusal
A page whose line fx could not read, ended by the grace, is not a refusal: fx says nothing about the list
A page that a grace ended on a line another request could have written is refused as unreadable, though its own answer is only late
old:
/\ lastAnswer' = lastAnswer
    /\ refused' = refused
    /\ unavail' = unavail
    /\ graceLine' = IF
new:
/\ lastAnswer' = "unreadable"
    /\ refused' = TRUE
    /\ unavail' = unavail
    /\ graceLine' = IF

description: A listing counts only its last page's tools left out, so an earlier page's are forgotten
An invalid cursor drops the pages gathered but not what they counted, so the count reaches the next pages
old:
/\ gatherDrop' = FALSE
               /\ runDrop' = FALSE
               /\ UNCHANGED <<dropped, listedDrop>>
new:
/\ gatherDrop' = gatherDrop
               /\ runDrop' = FALSE
               /\ UNCHANGED <<dropped, listedDrop>>

description: A listing that fails changes the count of the list that is still served
old:
/\ gatherDrop' = FALSE
    /\ runDrop' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dropped, listedDrop>>
new:
/\ gatherDrop' = FALSE
    /\ runDrop' = FALSE
    /\ dropped' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED listedDrop

description: A list that kept every tool leaves the earlier list's count in place
A listing that fails keeps what its pages counted, so the count reaches the next listing
old:
/\ gatherDrop' = FALSE
    /\ runDrop' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dropped, listedDrop>>
new:
/\ gatherDrop' = gatherDrop
    /\ runDrop' = runDrop
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dropped, listedDrop>>

description: A published list leaves the refusal's kind, so a list that was not refused is called unavailable
A new process keeps the refusal's kind of the one before it
old:
/\ unavail' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cacheGen, cachedZero, cachedLapsed, listingVars, servedStale, extraFetch>>
new:
/\ unavail' = unavail
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cacheGen, cachedZero, cachedLapsed, listingVars, servedStale, extraFetch>>

description: A page whose line fx could not read keeps the kind of the refusal before it, though it has no status
A listing the server never answered says its list is unavailable
old:
/\ lastAnswer' = lastAnswer
    /\ unavail' = unavail
    /\ UNCHANGED <<era, process, gen, cache, cacheGen, cachedZero, cachedLapsed, startGen,
                   page, restarts, zeroTtl, lapsed, servedStale, extraFetch>>

\* list_changed
new:
/\ lastAnswer' = lastAnswer
    /\ unavail' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<era, process, gen, cache, cacheGen, cachedZero, cachedLapsed, startGen,
                   page, restarts, zeroTtl, lapsed, servedStale, extraFetch>>

\* list_changed
